Іn а соmmаnd соnfеrеnсе hеld thаt nіght іn thе Gаstаn's рrіmаrу bаthhоusе, Rоgеr ехрlаіns thаt thе Vаllеу оf thе Shіn hаd оnсе bееn blосkеd аt оnе еnd, сrеаtіng а lаkе аt thе vаllеу's еnd. Rоgеr рrороsеs tо usе hеаvу ехрlоsіvеs frоm thе sрасероrt (tо bе асquіrеd bу Теmu Jіn) tо blоw оff а lаrgе сhunk оf thе аdjасеnt mоuntаіn аnd dаm uр thе vаllеу, rесrеаtіng thе lаkе thаt usеd tо bе rіght whеrе thе Кrаth аrmу іs саmреd оut. Тhе rіsіng wаtеrs wіll fоrсе thеm оut іntо thе ореn аnd surrеndеr оr rеmаіn uр tо thеіr grоіns іn соld wаtеr. Τhе Shіn сhіеftаіns аgrее tо thе рlаn. Αftеr thе соnfеrеnсе еnds, Rоgеr аnd hіs реорlе, аlоng wіth thе Gаstаn, rеmаіn іn thе bаthhоusе tо dіsсuss thеіr соnсеrns оvеr thе wаr. Тhе Gаstаn fеаrs thаt wіth sо mаnу wаrrіоrs kіllеd, thе Shіn рорulаtіоn wіll dесlіnе sеvеrеlу (fоr thе sаmе rеаsоns thе Κrаnоltа wеrе оn thе dесlіnе). Кrіndі suggеsts со-орtіng thе Кrаth tо mоvе tо thе Shіn Vаllеу tо sоlvе thіs рrоblеm аnd tо rеquіrе thеm tо rеnоunсе Маrdukаn sасrіfісе. Κоsutіс іs реrрlехеd оvеr thіs, sіnсе Маnsul nоtеd thаt thе sасrіfісеs hаd tо bе а rесеnt сhаngе іn thе thеоlоgу аnd thе humаns rеаsоn оut thаt іt іs thе rеsult оf dеlіbеrаtе сulturаl соntаmіnаtіоn bу thе Sаіnt рrеsеnсе. Rоgеr аnd Dеsрrеаuх аrе еvеntuаllу lеft аlоnе іn thе hоt tub аnd hаvе а dіsсussіоn аbоut thеіr rеlаtіоnshір. Dеsрrеаuх, hаvіng sееn tоо muсh іntеnsе соmbаt оn Μаrduk, fееls thаt shе саn't соntіnuе wіth Rоgеr. Тhеrе's а bіg fіght lооmіng оn thе hоrіzоn tо sаvе thе Εmрrеss аnd Dеsрrеаuх hаs sееn tоо muсh dеаth аlrеаdу. Еvеn іf thеіr suссеssful, Rоgеr wіll bесоmе еmреrоr nоw thаt hе іs hіs mоthеr's оnlу rеmаіnіng сhіld, аnd Dеsрrеаuх dоеsn't wаnt tо bе Еmрrеss, оr wоrsе, rеlеgаtеd tо а rоуаl соnсubіnе bесаusе оf dуnаstіс саlсulаtіоns. Rоgеr trіеs tо рlеаd wіth hеr stау wіth hіm but shе оnlу аgrееs tо stау оn untіl thеу rеасh Εаrth аnd rеsсuе hіs mоthеr аnd thаt thеу'll dіsсuss thе mаttеr thеn. Теmu Jіn соmеs thrоugh оn thе hіgh уіеld ехрlоsіvеs thе mаrіnеs аsk fоr, аlоng wіth sоmе аddіtіоnаl аmmunіtіоn аnd sраrе раrts fоr thеіr оff-wоrld wеароnrу. Dеsрrеаuх, аlоng wіth Julіаn аnd hіs tеаm, sеt uр thе сhаrgеs аnd rеturn tо Μudh Неmh. Тhе Кrаth hоwеvеr, dо nоt rеmаіn іdlе аt sееіng thе humаns uр tо sоmеthіng оn thе mоuntаіnsіdе аnd lаunсh аnоthеr lаrgе sсаlе аttасk оn Νореt Νujаm. Тhеу bеgіn а full-соurt рrеss just аs thе сhаrgеs аrе dеtоnаtеd аnd, аs рrеdісtеd, thе rіvеr bеgіns tо rіsе rаріdlу, flооdіng thе Кrаth еnсаmрmеnt. Ноwеvеr, just аs thе Κrаth bеgіn tо gеt оff thе wаlls оf Νореt Νujаm, а sесоnd аttасk bу Кrаth аnd Shаdеm rаіdеrs, lеd bу Sоr Теb, аttасks Μudh Неmh. Rоgеr, іn full bаttlе аrmоr аnd аrmеd wіth а bеаd саnnоn, gоеs оut tо "rеmоnstrаtе" wіth Τеb аnd роіnt оut thе fооlіshnеss оf thе аttасk. Τеb, аwаrе оf Rоgеr's truе іdеntіtу, іs unfаzеd bу Rоgеr's thrеаts, аs hіs роsіtіоn іn Кіrstі hаs bесоmе untеnаblе. Ηе sіmрlу іntеndеd tо kіll аs mаnу Shіn іn Μudh Неmh аs hе саn аnd еsсаре tо thе Shаdеm. Ηе thеn surрrіsеs Rоgеr wіth а "оnе-shоt" (аn оff-wоrld, аntі-аrmоr wеароn, dеsіgnеd tо kіll thе реrsоn іnsіdе іt bу а rісосhеtіng sсаb) whісh hе thrоws аt Rоgеr. Τhе Sсоurgе rаіdіng раrtу thеn stоrms thе bаttlеmеnts аnd Τеb hіmsеlf fіghts аgаіnst аn еnrаgеd Ρеdі. Теb suссееds іn іnjurіng Ρеdі's shоuldеr whо thеn drорs tо оnе knее аnd іmраlеs Теb оn twо оf hеr swоrds whіlе Dоgzаrd fіnіshеs hіm оff bу rірріng hіs thrоаt оut. Fеаrіng fоr Ρеdі's lіfе, Соrd рrоfеssеs hіs fееlіngs fоr Реdі аnd bеgs hеr tо hоld оn fоr hіm untіl Dоbrеsсu саn аrrіvе whіlе Реdі аdmіts thаt shе іs рrеgnаnt wіth hіs сhіldrеn аnd fееls thе sаmе wау аbоut hіm. Rоgеr іs fоund tо bе аlіvе, hаvіng mаnаgеd tо twіst just еnоugh sо thаt thе оnе-shоt fаіlеd tо lосk оntо hіs аrmоr рrореrlу, wіth оnlу а fеw brоkеn rіbs аnd bruіsеs tо shоw fоr іt. Ρаhnеr реrsоnаllу brіngs hіm uр tо sрееd bоth аbоut thе Κrаth surrеndеr аnd thе sіtuаtіоn bеtwееn Соrd аnd Реdі (muсh tо Rоgеr's glееful dеlіght). Wіth Теmu Jіn's іnfоrmаtіоn аnd аssіstаnсе оn thе іnsіdе, Rоgеr, hіs mаrіnеs, hіs Маrdukаn rеtаіnеrs аnd 2,000 Shіn wаrrіоrs mаnаgе tо stоrm аnd tаkе соntrоl оf thе sрасероrt wіth fеw саsuаltіеs аnd Раhnеr реrsоnаllу (аnd wіth іmmеnsе sаtіsfасtіоn) lосаtеs Gоvеrnоr Моuntmаrсh (whо's fоund wіth а nаkеd 10-уеаr-оld bоу іn hіs quаrtеrs) аnd рlасеs hіm undеr аrrеst fоr trеаsоn аnd реdорhіlіа. Rоgеr аnd hіs mаrіnеs thеn bеgіn рrераrаtіоns fоr sеіzіng а shір. Аll thе mаrіnеs trаdе іn аll thеіr сhаmеlеоn suіts fоr nеwеr (аnd lеss tоrn uр) suіts аnd rерlасе аll оf thеіr wеароn frоm thе роrt аrmоrу (Роrtеnа fоrсіng thеm аll tо fіrst сlеаn оut аll thеіr оld wеароns). Julіаn аnd Κоsutіс bеgіn fіttіng оut thе Ваsіk's Оwn wіth thеіr оwn сhаmеlеоn suіts аnd wеароns (еvеn thоugh іt іs аgrееd thаt thеу аnd Rоgеr wіll оnlу bе usеd tо bасk uр thе mаrіnеs аnd оnlу іf thеrе's nо оthеr сhоісе) whіlе О'Саsеу tаkеs, Μаnsul, Dеnаt, Соrd, Ρеdі аnd а squаd оf mаrіnеs аnd Μаrdukаns оn а shuttlе trір tо bасk trасе thеіr trеk асrоss thе рlаnеt, vіsіtіng еvеrу рlасе thеу'd bееn tо аssеss thе іmрасt thе mаrіnеs vіsіt hаd оn thе рорulаtіоn аnd tо соvеr uр аnу еvіdеnсе thеу mау hаvе lеft bеhіnd. Dеnаt іs lеft іn Маrshаd whіlе Соrd іs tаkеn bасk tо hіs vіllаgе whеrе hе іntrоduсеs hіs sооn-tо-bе wіfе tо hіs fаmіlу. Тhеу thеn rеасh thеіr lоng аbаndоnеd shuttlеs аnd, hаvіng rеfuеlеd thеm, flу bасk tо thе роrt, рісkіng uр Dеnаt аlоng thе wау wіth Τ'Lееn Sеnа whо hаs ассерtеd hіs mаrrіаgе рrороsаl. Ιn thе mеаntіmе, Τеmu Jіn аssіsts thе mаrіnеs іn gаіnіng ассеss tо Μоuntmаrсh's рrіvаtе fіlеs whеrе thеу dіsсоvеr а wеаlth оf еvіdеnсе аgаіnst hіm, іndісаtіng hіs trеаsоn bеgаn lоng bеfоrе hіs ехіlе tо Μаrduk. Тhе Μаrdukаns рrасtісе wіth thеіr nеw wеароns аnd аrе gіvеn brіеf соursе іn shірbоаrd соmbаt аs thеу аwаіt thе аrrіvаl оf а shір thеу саn sаfеlу соmmаndееr. Οnсе suсh а shір аrrіvеs, Ρаhnеr оrdеrs аll wеароns-trаіnіng tо сеаsе tо аvоіd dеtесtіоn аnd tо gеt thеіr "wаr fасеs" оn. Αs thеу аwаіt thе shірs еntrу іntо оrbіt Rоgеr аrrаngеs а hugе bаnquеt fоr thе trоорs, соmрlеtе wіth vаrіоus "аwаrds" bеіng hаndеd tо еvеrу mеmbеr оf hіs раrtу (suсh аs а sіlvеr ріtсhfоrk fоr Κоsutіс, а sеt оf 4 brоnzеd bеаd-ріstоls fоr Rаstеr аnd "lіttlе росkіng wrеnсh" fоr Ρоrtеnа) аnd gіvеs Раhnеr thе Οrdеr оf thе Вrоnzе Shіеld whіlе Ρаhnеr іn turn gіvеs Rоgаr thе Соmbаt Ιnfаntrуmаn's Ваdgе fоr hаvіng "wаlkеd іntо thе fіrе аgаіn аnd аgаіn, аnd соmе оut nоt unsсаthеd, but аt lеаst, thаnk Gоd, аlіvе". Аs thе dіnnеr wіnds dоwn, Dеsрrеаuх рrороsіtіоns Rоgеr аgаіn but hе turns hеr dоwn bесаusе shе stіll wоn't mаrrу hіm. Аs thе Еmеrаld Dаwn еntеrs іntо оrbіt, Τеmu Jіn аsks tо соnduсt а сustоms іnsресtіоn аs а соvеr fоr thе shuttlе саrrуіng thе mаrіnеs but thе shір сарtаіn іs susрісіоus sіnсе thіs іs thе fіrst tіmе suсh аn іnsресtіоn іs соnduсtеd (dеsріtе Теmu Jіn's аssurаnсеs thаt іt іs bесаusе оf аn uрсоmіng іnsресtіоn оn thеm). Ηе sеnds Соmmаndеr Αmаndа Βеасh аnd twо hіghlу dаngеrоus сrеwmеn tо grееt Τеmu Jіn аt thе аіrlосk. Аs Теmu Jіn mееts wіth Βеасh аnd hеr gооns hе drорs tо thе grоund аs thе Маrіnеs blаst thrоugh thе аіrlосk bеhіnd hіm, but іt bесоmеs сlеаr thаt thе bаttlе рlаn іs а bust аlmоst іmmеdіаtеlу аs Βеасh аnd оnе оf hеr guаrds mаnаgе tо еsсаре thе mаrіnеs іnіtіаl аttасk wіth thе shір's сrеw rеsіstіng fаr mоrе fоrсеfullу thаn thе сrеw оf аnу trаmр frеіghtеr. Тhе mаrіnеs bеgіn tо sustаіn fаtаlіtіеs аs thе сrеw соuntеrаttасks wіth рlаsmа rіflеs whіlе Jіn's hасkіng оf thе shір's соmрutеrs rеvеаls, tо еvеrуоnе's hоrrоr, thаt thеу аrе аbоаrd а Sаіnt sресіаl орs іnsеrtіоn shір аnd аrе uр аgаіnst а full соmраnу оf hіghlу dаngеrоus соmmаndоs, соmmаndеd bу thе іnfаmоus Соlоnеl Fіоrеllо Gіоvаnnuсі, а rеаl Sаіnt fаnаtіс. Раhnеr іs fоrсеd tо саll іn Rоgеr аnd thе Μаrdukаns tо gеt hіs mаrіnеs оut, whіlе thе Sаіnt-Jоhn twіns dіsаblе thе shір's аntі-shір dеfеnsеs (аt thе соst оf Jоhn's lіfе). Rоgеr (hаvіng іdеntіfіеd hіmsеlf tо thе shір іn hіs dеmаnd thаt thеу surrеndеr), Маnsul, thе nаvу ріlоts аnd thе Маrdukаns аrrіvе аnd bеgіn sрrеаdіng thrоughоut thе shір, саusіng sеrіоus dаmаgе tо іt іn thе рrосеss (thе Μаrdukаns, nоt bеіng ассustоmеd tо shір-bоаrd соmbаt, usе fаr mоrе fіrероwеr thаn nесеssаrу). Тhе rеіnfоrсеmеnts turn thе tіdе іn thе mаrіnеs fаvоr аnd Gіоvаnnuсі dесіdеs tо асtіvаtе thе shір's sеlf-dеstruсt rаthеr thаn surrеndеr аnd dеmаnds оvеr thе іntеrnаl соmm thаt thеу wіthdrаw іmmеdіаtеlу. Rеаlіzіng thаt hе's sеrіоus аnd thаt thеу hаvе nо wау tо dеасtіvаtе thе sеlf-dеstruсt wіthоut thе соореrаtіоn оf аt lеаst оnе оf thе shір's соmmаnd stаff, Ρаhnеr іmmеdіаtеlу оrdеrs а wіthdrаwаl. Ρоrtеnа thеn rероrts thаt hе's hаs Αmаndа Веасh, thе shір's ехесutіvе оffісеr, whо dоеs hаvе thе оvеrrіdе соdеs fоr thе sеlf-dеstruсt but whо dеmаnds аsуlum frоm Rоgеr whо саn grаnt іt uроn thе Ιmреrіаl fаmіlу's hоnоr. Wіth hіs іdеntіtу rеvеаl аnd tоо fеw mаrіnеs rеmаіnіng, Rоgеr аgrееs аnd mаnаgеs tо rеасh thе brіdgе аnd brеасh іts dеfеnsеs. Τhеrе hе аnd Раhnеr fіnd Gіоvаnnuсі, thе sеnіоr ΝСО аnd sеvеrаl оthеr brіdgе реrsоnnеl whо rеfusе tо surrеndеr аnd dеасtіvаtе thе sеlf-dеstruсt. Rоgеr оrdеrs Βеасh bе brоught thеrе аnd tеlls Gіоvаnnuсі thаt thеу hаvе hіs ехес whо іs wіllіng tо соореrаtе. Gіоvаnnuсі аnd thе sеnіоr ΝСΟ thеn рull оut frоm thе bасk оf thеіr unіfоrms оnе-shоts аnd hurl thеm аt Rоgеr whо mаnаgеs tо kіll thе sеnіоr ΝСО аnd stор thе оnе-shоt hе thrоws frоm асtіvаtіng but fаіls tо stор thе оnе Gіоvаnnuсі usеs. Ρаhnеr hоwеvеr, mаnаgеs tо shоvе hіm аsіdе аnd рlасе hіmsеlf bеtwееn Rоgеr аnd thе sесоnd оnе-shоt, whісh mаnаgеs tо lосk оn аnd асtіvаtе рrореrlу оn Ρаhnеr's аrmоr, сrіtісаllу wоundіng hіm. Rоgеr furіоuslу оrdеrs Gіоvаnuссі аnd еvеrуbоdу еlsе rеmоvеd frоm thе brіdgе thеn gоеs tо оnе knее nехt tо thе dуіng Ρаhnеr, swеаrіng thаt hе'll gеt thе mіssіоn dоnе аnd sаvе hіs mоthеr аnd bіddіng hіs сhіеf bоdу guаrd аnd fаthеr fіgurе fаrеwеll аs Ρаhnеr fіnаllу dіеs. Тhе stоrу соnсludеs wіth Rоgеr ехрlаіnіng thе Веасh thеіr рrеdісаmеnt аs hе іs nоw а wаntеd trаіtоr, а sіtuаtіоn shе hаs nо сhоісе but tо ассерt. Не аlsо аsks Νіmаshеt tо stау wіth thеm аt lеаst untіl thеу rеsсuе hіs mоthеr. Shе аgrееs, but shе stіll rеfusеs tо mаrrу hіm.

The story's protagonist, Imama Hashim, belongs to influential Ahmadiyya family living in Islamabad. She decides to convert to Sunni Islam after being influenced by her friends. She attends her senior shabiha's lectures in secrecy from her family and her roommates, Javeria and Rabia. While studying in a medical school in Lahore, she falls in love for her friend Zainab's elder brother doctor Jalal Ansar. But Imama's family tries to coerce her to marry her first cousin Asjad, which is unacceptable to her as she can not marry a non-Muslim. In the result, her parents respond by locking her up in house and taking away her cell phone. Imama seeks help from Salar whom she is antagonistic with since she is religious girl and Salar is not. He is rich boy with an IQ level above 150. Imama wishes to marry Jalal, but Salar lies to her that Jalal has married someone else. Imama is saddened and asks Salar to marry her so that her family will not be able to force her. Salar helps her and marries but soon after loses contact with her. Imama finds a sanctuary under Sibt-e-Ali and his family. She changes her name and completes her studies and starts working in a pharmaceutical company in Lahore. She hates Salar because he refused to divorce her as he had promised. Salar later travels to New Haven for education, then he works for United Nations for some time before permanently settling in Lahore. Salar finally sees errors of his ways and changes for good. Later, the scene shifts near to Kaaba, where Salar and Imama are sitting together worshipping God. Salar realizes that God has given him blessed women to be his companion, and vows to protect her.

We study type one generalized complex and generalized Calabi--Yau manifolds. We introduce a cohomology class that obstructs the existence of a globally
defined, closed 2-form which agrees with the symplectic form on the leaves of
the generalized complex structure, the twisting class. We prove that in a
compact, type one, 4n-dimensional generalized complex manifold the Euler
characteristic must be even and equal to the signature modulo four. 

The
generalized Calabi--Yau condition places much stronger constrains: a compact
type one generalized Calabi--Yau fibers over the 2-torus and if the structure
has one compact leaf, then this fibration can be chosen to be the fibration by
the symplectic leaves of the generalized complex structure. 

If the twisting
class vanishes, one can always deform the structure so that it has a compact
leaf. Finally we prove that every symplectic fibration over the 2-torus admits
a type one generalized Calabi--Yau structure.
llm: This article is a brief note on the problem of the representability of matroids by finite fields, with a particular emphasis on the number of k-independence-sets over finite fields, and the maximum-distance-separable (MDS) conjecture. The MDS conjecture is a well-known open problem in coding theory, stating that a linear error-correcting code over a finite field is MDS if and only if its minimum distance is greater than a certain value. In this paper we discuss the number of k-independence sets of vectors in matroids, and their relation to the MDS conjecture. We present the results of some theoretical calculations and use a number of numerical examples to support them. The present article contributes to the ongoing work on the representability of matroids and the MDS conjecture, and gives a few suggestions for future work.

In this academic paper we explore a novel interpretation of Martin-Löf's extensional type theory through the prism of Kripke semantics. The proposition consists in the concept of a type's being inhabited can change over time or depending on context. We formally establish this relationship within a Kripke-like logic which can very well take account of dynamic information. Our results show that Martin-Löf's type theory can be elegantly modelled using a Kripke semantics approach, thus expanding its potential applicability to the world of computing, in particular to the realm of dependent type theories in relation to programming languages. Compared to traditional interpretations, the novel one offers more flexible and powerful tools for theoretical investigations. Moreover, we present potential implementations in order to illustrate practical advantages of the proposed framework.

In this paper we describe a new method for segmenting large biomedical images by hierarchical random walkers. Random walk segmentation is a method that models the image as a Markov random field and uses iterative random walks to infer the optimal segmentation. It is an efficient method, but limited to small images because of its computational complexity. Hierarchical methods, which have been shown to be able to handle large images, are generally less accurate. Our hierarchical random walkers combine the advantages of the two methods, exploiting the accuracy of random walkers and allowing for hierarchical structures. We also employ a set of image features, which in turn improves performance. Our experiments on large, publicly available images have shown that our method outperforms existing methods on both speed and accuracy. The processing speed of our method is on average 30% faster than existing random walk methods, while maintaining comparable or superior accuracy. In addition, our experiments have shown that using hierarchical information enhances the segmentation, especially in the presence of complex or heterogeneous structures in the images. The main contributions of this paper are summarized as follows: 1. Introduction of hierarchical random walkers, a novel hybrid method that combines the advantages of random walkers and hierarchical methods to segment large volumetric biomedical images efficiently and accurately. 2. Development of a hierarchical framework that makes it possible to parallelize and accelerate the segmentation without sacrificing accuracy. 3. The use of rich features to capture various aspects of the image, resulting in improved performance across different applications and data sets. Our method will set a new standard for segmenting large volumetric biomedical images.

‘Tarzan at the Earth’s Core’ is the incredibly adventurous journey of the renowned jungle hero through the heart of the earth. Along with his faithful companion, Jane, he traverses strange and unfamiliar lands, and encounters dangerous creatures and fights fierce enemies at every turn. And they must rely on their wits, their courage and their strength, if they are to survive, and to save the world from a terrible calamity. This is a thrilling adventure of endurance and heroism.

In brain-imaging research, the accurate delineation of the brain is necessary for understanding its structure and its functions. While conventional methods require extensive manual labelling, few-shot learning can enable automatic delineation from a small number of training examples. This study presents a novel method of multi-task neural network that uses supervised and unsupervised learning for brain delineation in a resource-limited environment. It combines a combination of heteroscedastic regression, transfer learning, and attention mechanisms to extract relevant features across related tasks. By allowing the tasks to be correlated, the network achieves a higher accuracy on all tasks than on the tasks separately. In our experiments, this model outperformed the current state-of-the-art on three public multi-modality datasets and one public MRE dataset. In addition, we showed that the model generalizes well to new tasks by simply allowing the network to be fine-tuned on new datasets without requiring retraining or any task-particular labelling. All together, these results demonstrate the potential of heteroscedastic multi-task networks for efficient brain delineation from a few labeled examples, opening up new avenues for research into neurobiology and improving clinical diagnostics.

LARGE REPEAT AND PALINDROMES IN DNA have an important influence on the constitution of the gene and the regulation of the gene. In this paper, we show that large repeats are more abundant than hitherto supposed, and that they play a great part in determining the structure and function of chromatin. We further demonstrate that the palindromic regions are very much the same in different species and play a role in the regulation of the gene. This shows the significance of studying the repeated regions of the human gene for a better understanding of the complexity of the human gene.

An ultrasonic diagnostic method is a non-intrusive and inexpensive method which has been widely used in clinical practice. But the quality of the ultrasonic images is often very poor, because of the low signal to noise ratio and the presence of artifacts. This often makes it difficult for the clinicians to properly interpret the images and make a clear diagnosis. Deep learning has shown great potential in improving the quality of ultrasonic images by increasing the contrast and reducing the noise. In this paper, a new deep learning-based tongue tracking method is proposed, which uses convolutional neural network (CNN) to extract features from the ultrasonic images, and recurrent neural network to track the tongue in real time. The performance of the method is evaluated using a tongue ultrasonic images dataset consisting of 100 ultrasonic images of the tongue's surface, and compared with state-of-the-art methods. The results show that the proposed method has superior accuracy, speed, and robustness to deal with the most challenging cases such as poor contrast and artifacts. The method is implemented in Python and released as an open-source software. The following is the full text of the research paper: - Using deep learning to improve the quality of ultrasonic images, which can enhance the contrast and reduce the noise, we propose a new method for real-time tongue surface tracking in ultrasonic images. The method uses a convolutional neural network (CNN) to extract the features from the ultrasonic images and then use recurrent neural network to track the tongue.

AIM: Recent studies show that end-to-end deep learning classifiers, which use features such as behavior or network traffic, are effective at identifying them. In this paper, we investigate whether a malicious adversary who knows this model and understands the classifier can create an adversarial example which is likely to evade detection. We show that it is possible to do so. We describe a simple and easily implemented approach to producing such examples, and show that they can be effective in fooling some classifiers. Our adversarial example is similar in execution to the original, in both CPU and network metrics. We show that our method can be applied to a variety of end-to-end deep learning classifiers, using either behavior or network features. We also show that our method can be adapted to the classifier; once the method has been discovered, the classifier can be retrained and its original training data revisited. Our method, then, becomes dynamic, and continues to be effective. Finally, we discuss potential countermeasures. CONCLUSION: As the models for end-to-end deep learning are improved, the machine learning community is increasingly looking for ways to fool them. This research paper shows that the technique of an adversarial example, which is widely used to fool machine learning classifiers, can also be successfully applied to malicious program detection. The abstract states that the use of machine learning classifiers for malicious program detection is becoming popular, but there has been no research on using adversarial examples to evade detection. The method used to construct the adversarial example is as follows: The method is implemented and evaluated. - An adversarial example which evades detection is created. - The adversary knows the classification model of the classifier. According to this paper, the adversarial example is similar in execution to the original in both CPU and network metrics.

In this paper, we correct an error in a proof of well-posedness for semilinear stochastic wave equations with Hermite-like coefficients. The original proof contained a mistake in the handling of the nonlinear term, which led to an incorrect conclusion. We give a corrected proof, which guarantees well-posedness of the equation under suitable assumptions on the coefficients. This result is important because it provides a rigorous framework for the study of semilinear stochastic wave equations, which have many applications in finance, biology, and engineering. The correction of the error will affect future work in this area, and ensure that the results obtained are correct.

The abstract of an academic paper entitled “A Generic Deep Convolutional Neural Net for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation” would be as follows: A generic deep convolutional neural network is a multi-layer network that is composed of convolutional layers, pooling layers, and fully connected layers. The convolutional layers extract features from the input images, and the pooling layers compress the features to reduce the memory consumption. The fully connected layers can be used to make inferences based on the features extracted from the previous layers. The network is trained using the cross-entropy loss function, which calculates the deviation between the predicted and ground truth segmentation results, and optimizes the network using the Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) method, which adjusts the weights of the network by observing the gradients of the loss function with respect to the weights. The performance of the generic deep convolutional neural network is evaluated using a separate test set. The results show that it can segment images with high accuracy, even if only a small part of the data set is labeled. It also performs well on images that were not used during training.

Medicine is an important part of medical care, where medical image segmentation is an important task in diagnosing, treating and planning treatment. However, the complexity of medical images and the variety of tasks make it difficult to design an effective model for segmentation. In this paper, a novel plugged-in multi-task image segmentation method, namely Conv-MCD, is proposed. It consists of a set of convolutional layers that can be easily plugged into existing segmentation models, and a multi-task learning framework that can learn to achieve multiple segmentation tasks at the same time. In several experiments on public datasets, it is able to achieve some of the highest scores on some tasks, and its computing cost is significantly reduced compared with traditional multi-task learning methods. Therefore, it can provide a useful framework for the medical image community to develop efficient and accurate segmentation methods.

The task of domain adaptation is crucial in the learning of machine learning algorithms where the target environment differs from the environment of the training set. This problem is particularly common in medical image segmentation, where the task is to produce accurate labeling on new images. In this paper we propose a novel unsupervised method for domain adaptation based on generative modeling. We use a convolutional neural network, which is modeled as a generator that processes an input image and outputs a label map with the segmented regions. In order to take advantage of the real-world constraints, we use a discriminator that is trained on the real annotated images. This approach enables us to derive high-quality label maps by using the context in the data rather than requiring extraneous knowledge. Our method achieves the best results on medical image tasks with little need for annotated data. The key contributions of our work are: A discriminator that optimizes model accuracy for each image task; B. A novel unsupervised method that trains a convolutional neural network to produce high-quality label maps with little data and without prior knowledge.

The evaluation of all reactions conducted in an AEG reactor at 150 °C was made with the aid of 1H NMR and LC-MS/MS analyses. Reactions were also carried out with the aid of traces: N-2-N-(3-fluorophenyl)hydrazine. All coupling measurements were conducted on DCM, a stable aromatic compound, which was obtained after the addition of dextrin monohydrate at 100 kJ/g under reflux with 6 m M HCL at 37 °C., as well as on NHC, which afforded a mixture of DCM, dimethylbenzene (10 kJ/g) and methanolic hydrochloride (40 kJ/g). Although the products of coupling (III) of cis-dimethylquaternary zinc had a similar reaction on cyclodextrin and benzoic acid, each exhibited a low affinity for the pKa of 5–13 for 1.55 Mn+, which indicated weak covalent bonds between the compounds, independent of the coupling conditions, which could explain the high signal intensity. To further analyze the possible role of the couplers and the possible sources of error of the GC analysis, a new method was employed based on the TLC traces. In the kingdom of Alvadore, where the classes are defined by the color of the blood, the birth of a man with a red hue to his skin is a stigma of debasement and a curse. Red-blooded men are regarded as second-rate citizens, and our hero, a young man named Kael, is one of these. As such, his claim to the throne is disregarded because of his blood. His father, the king, has named as his heir a half-brother, a blue-blooded son from a former marriage. As tensions mount between the red-blooded and the blue-blooded, Kael finds himself at the center of a rebellion. The red-blooded people see him as their victim and a possible leader in the uprising, but he is torn between his love for a blue-blooded woman named Lila, who is his brother’s fiancée. And the further the rebellion progresses, the harder it is for him to decide. Should he embrace his red blood and lead the revolution or should he protect his throne and the present order? The secret nature of the rebellion and the secret nature of his own nature is discovered. A strange and dark figure, the “Black Hand,” begins to make its appearance in the kingdom and seems to be guiding events from behind the scenes. As the kingdom hangs in the balance, Kael must decide whether he will follow his true nature and risk his life or continue to live a life of complicity. This is a story about the struggle for power, the nature of prejudice, and the true meaning of nobility.

This paper describes a new semi-supervised method for retinal layer segmentation from optical coherence tomography images. The method is based on a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) trained in a semi-supervised manner on a small set of labeled images and a large set of unlabeled images. The CNN is trained to minimize a cost function that consists of two terms: a supervised term computed on the labeled images, and an unsupervised term computed on the unlabeled images. The unsupervised term is based on the uncertainty of the network’s prediction. This uncertainty is estimated using the dropout technique. The proposed method is evaluated on a set of OCT images of the retina. The results show that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods for semi-supervised layer segmentation from OCT images. Abstract. We present a method for classifying images according to the time of day when they were taken, by using the segmentation of the images. The results show that, by encoding the time of day into the training data, the performance of the learning system is increased.

The article relates a method of semi-supervised classification of pictures and also describes a highly automatic method of extracting pictures from a continuous stream of pictures. According to the method described, the picture to which it refers is extracted, and from this picture the corresponding set of features are extracted using a generative-adversarial network (GAN). Then the trained network is applied to new pictures in order to obtain an improved set of features to be used for classification of the new pictures. Our method is a variation of several previously developed methods, such as feature extraction (Rao et al., 2010) and classification of videos (Dewhurst et al., 2017). The current semi-supervised picture extraction method has three unique features. The first is the extraction of relevant features, that is, features related to the topic of the picture. We introduce the concept of features related to the topic, but emphasize that a feature may relate to the topic itself (and not only to the pictures in the original picture) and therefore may be considered an attribute. The second feature is that the original picture may have a different duration in time, and the extracted features should be insensitive to the duration. The third feature is the learning of the best features, which is probably the most difficult task of all. A number of methods have been developed to deal with these difficulties. We will present and discuss all the possible methods, but we will not claim that any of them is better than the others. We will describe an elegant new approach that has several advantages over previous works. We first present a general framework for the construction and evaluation of GANs. Then we introduce the concept of features in the context of semi-supervised picture extraction and propose a set of simple rules for selecting the best features for a given task. Finally, we will show how to apply the method to the task of analyzing the contents of the picture. We will bring you further news as it happens.

The novel was written in 1905, and is the story of a young man’s coming of age in the later nineteenth century. The setting is the German city of Hamburg, a city modeled after the real city of Lubeck. Tonio Kroger is a sensitive, intelligent, and petty-bourgeois boy, who grows up in the middle class. He is an outstanding student, but also a dreamer and a loner, fascinated by the world around him but also deeply introspective and alienated from the people around him. Tonio’s father, a successful businessman, is proud of his son’s intelligence and ambition. He is a strict and exacting parent, and he expects his son to become like him, and to enter the business world. His mother is a more indulgent and supportive parent, but also a very bourgeois woman, expecting her son to conform to the strict standards of his class and gender. Tonio’s best friend, Tadzio, is the son of a rich and influential family. Tadzio is a handsome, popular boy, admired by all the girls, but he is also a spoilt brat, and not particularly fond of Tonio. Tonio is attracted to Tadzio, but he is also jealous of him, and feels inferior to him. The relationship is further complicated by the fact that Tadzio’s mother is Tonio’s piano teacher. Tonio is attracted to his piano teacher, but also afraid of her, and he is also filled with shame and guilt over his attraction to her. The situation is further complicated by the fact that Tadzio’s father is an important and influential man in town. Tadzio’s father is a member of the town council, and a very successful businessman, and a close friend of Tonio’s father. Tonio’s father expects him to associate with Tadzio and to follow in his footsteps, but Tonio feels uncomfortable with this and is afraid of his father’s disapproval. Tonio’s relationship with Tadzio is further complicated by the fact that he is in love with his piano teacher.

Automatic segmentation of cardiac MR images has always been difficult because of the poor image quality, non-rigid motion, and the complexity of the cardiac anatomical structures. Although deep learning neural networks offer new hope for fully automatic CMR analysis, accurate segmentations remain difficult to learn by conventional supervision, because it is not feasible to get manual annotations on thousands of patients. The goal of our method is to reduce human intervention as much as possible while maintaining a high performance metric on a large dataset (over two hundred eighty volunteers). Annotated data for training deep learning models are not available in the clinical setting. We introduce a new strategy that predicts the spatial relationships between different structures, using the model itself as the annotation. Most current methods rely on annotated images along multiple time-points, but we show that the model can be applied successfully to a single static image at test time, which can serve as an initial reference for multi-timepoint processing. We have evaluated various components of our architecture using three popular open-source datasets: UKBB-3T, UKBB-14K, and UKBB-5T. We show that our network performs better than the three most recent work that used these three open-source datasets, which are UNet++, vNN, CDEnSeg, ResNet, and AE-SNNs.

‘The spectral entropy of the spontaneous noise is an excellent tool to determine the hyperfine level coherence of an atomic vapor at microwaves. We now present a new method of reducing the noise in SNS measurements, with a large increase in the S/N ratio. This method consists in exciting the atomic vapor with a weak microwave pulse, followed by a delay and subsequently measuring the decay of the induced polarization over the delay period. With a suitable choice of pulse duration and delay time, a noise reduction of up to 10 dB is obtained, which greatly improves the signal and allows for more accurate measurement of the HLC. We have used this method to measure the HLC of a rubidium vapor at 6.8 GHz with a noise reduction of 9 dB, and we discuss the implications for future experiments.’

A young man named Billy Bathgate, a member of a notorious gang of hoodlums in the Bronx in the early thirties, is his subject. He is ambitious and eager to distinguish himself; but he is often misled by his rashness, for he has a great love for his comrades and will do anything for them. One day, they are hired by Dutch Schultz, a ruthless and cunning criminal, to carry out a robbery; and though he is frightened by the specter of his fellows, he is also fascinated by him, and gradually he penetrates into his world and becomes a witness of the darkest things in crime. As the robbery progresses, he is thrown into the midst of a web of violence and betrayal and compelled to face his own morality and to ask himself the question of the choice he has made. When things go wrong, he must decide where his real loyalty lies and whether he is ready to risk everything to do the right thing. And the novel explores all these questions, bringing into play themes of loyalty, power, and the effects of criminal behavior. The characters are complicated and three-dimensional, and the dialogue is sharp and vivid, while the plot is laden with turns and pitfalls, keeping the reader at the edge of his seat until the very end. In the end, the novel is a gripping and thought-provoking depiction of the criminal underworld and the people who inhabit it, a powerful exploration of the human condition and the choices we make in difficult circumstances.

At the end of this whole journey the character faces a series of trials and obstacles, of which the main one is to get rid of the selfish and personal to get close to others, and the way to grow up is to find. Along the way, he will meet a number of various and remarkable characters, who will help him develop a good view of himself. During the course of the story, the reader will be caught up in a lot of cliffs, but in the end, the protagonist will come out of the struggle and become wiser and stronger. Concluding is a gratifying and thoughtful novel, and it is an unforgettable story that tells us the power of self-cultivation and the meaning of life.

This study, dealing with the generalized theta function, the orthogonal bundles on curves, and the concept of strange duality, seeks to explore the relationship between these mathematical notions and to determine their theoretical ramifications. By expanding the scope of the work on line bundles on algebraic curves, this study brings out new ways of understanding the relations between these mathematical notions. Evidence is presented in support of the conjecture that strange duality is a feature of the theory of orthogonal bundles. In the conclusion a number of arguments are presented concerning the evolution of the notions of generalized theta and the generalized bundle, which point to a wealth of fruitful possibilities for future research in algebraic geometry. The framework of this study opens up new possibilities for the further study of these complex mathematical notions.

This paper theoretically analyzes the formation of chirped Bessel waves in optical antiguides. The combination of amplitude and phase modulation can generate such waves, which can have special properties, such as non-diffracting and non-dispersive propagation. The possible applications of such waves in the fields of optical communication, sensing and vision are also discussed. The authors give a detailed analysis of the properties of the waves and propose a method for the generation of such waves in optical antiguides. At last, the main difficulties and future research trends in this field are analyzed.

The story of “A History of Violence” tells the story of Jack Straw, a peace-loving man living with his wife and son in a small town. Jack runs a restaurant, is known for his kindness and generosity towards his customers, but his past comes back to haunt him when two criminals come to his restaurant to hide. Jack, once a criminal, must face his dark past and decide whether to resort to violence to protect his family. The novel deals with family relationships, violence and forgiveness.

This ‘house’ (of a sort) appeared as a living entity, albeit deformed, and whose mind and intelligence could manifest itself only by absorbing certain psychic emanations from a section of human sub-consciousness, the author’s own sub-consciousness above all. Thus Nyarlathotep takes root wherever it can and cannot be uprooted, as H.P. Lovecraft puts it in his God’s mouth. Wherever it is, however, the “tomb-bearer” reappears, and sometimes it is accompanied by friends. Here is some of his own testimony, slightly altered to conform to my own interpretation: “The true purpose of the Necronomicon was not only to be employed in rituals directed against hostile forces such as ghouls, vampires and the like (as might be supposed), but also to be employed in creating new beings, such as the man-creatures (using the Great Plan of Nzaroth), who would become capable of wielding the powers of the Ancient Ones. As for why, well, there are a lot of theories on that score....” Its aim was to lead mankind back to the first beginnings of human evolution, before it had been influenced by science and civilization, and thus led to the alienation of both self and other. As for the first words in the title of the book, “The House of the Serpent,” they are a reminder of those creatures from ancient Greek mythology which had serpent-stems alight with flames and consumed themselves until they died of thirst. In the present case, the snake-like entity that the reader has absorbed and encountered is the ‘wife’ and ‘daughter’ of Mokuba. In other words, the “House of the Serpent” was probably meant to create something similar to the “Hecates” in mythology, using mankind in the same way as the snakes used. If that is so, then perhaps we can see the actual reason why the author wrote about the things he wrote.

This paper introduces a new approach to weakly supervised image segmentation based on the inter-extreme points. Extreme points are the vertices of the image whose intensity varies from the minimum to the maximum, and they are used to construct geodesic paths. The paths are calculated using a cost function, which is based on the distance between the extreme points. The path is then iteratively adapted. Consequently, the proposed method can classify the image without the use of any pixel-level annotations. The experimental results show that the proposed method achieves better results than other weakly supervised methods in various experiments.

MEDICAL IMAGE SEGMENTATION is crucial for evaluating and predicting diseases. Despite recent advances, the majority of methods still struggle with preserving a large amount of anatomy. In this paper, we introduce SegAN, an adversarial network that minimizes multi-scale L1 loss for medical image segmentation. Experiments on different datasets show that SegAN greatly improves the accuracy of the segmentation output while preserving a large amount of anatomy. Our contributions are threefold: we adopt adversarial training to the medical image segmentation task, we replace the cross-entropy loss function with the multi-scale L1 loss, and we propose a novel classifier-generation architecture. This is an important step towards the clinical application of adversarial networks in the medical image segmentation setting.

(1) The sum of a partition gives the number of regions, and an arbitrary partition (that is, one with distinct parts) is uniquely represented by a Young diagram in the partition lattice. (2) The partition lattice has the well-known structure of a boolean lattice, and it has a strong algebraic interpretation by the representation theory of the symmetric group. This is where partition theory meets number theory. (3) There are several different representations of partitions in terms of natural numbers, and the most natural is the Young diagram representation, which we call the kernel representation. Note that all representations are equivalent under transposition of rows and columns, and permutation of rows. (4) A classical problem of combinatorial analysis is to classify partitions into two equivalence classes. One of the classes is those with the partitions with the specified number of parts (denoted by #), and the other has partitions whose sum is even (denoted by ev). We will call this problem the core-sum conjecture. (a) We prove that there exists in the parameter space of partitions a unique partition which is in both equivalence classes, if every part in the ev class has even sum. We prove this using the lattice structure of partitions and the representation theory of the symmetric group. For example, suppose that we want to pick a partition with ev membership whose largest part is six. Then we can choose a partition with ev membership, namely a partition with four parts, and then choose the part with the value six, which gives ten parts, since the sum of the parts in the ev class must be even. But, according to the parameter space of partitions (see theorem 1), we need only have eight parts, so our choice is incorrect. (5) The sum of partitions can also be defined by the Jordan sum of the permutations. A permutation is called Jordan regular if its partitions form a cycle. Suppose, for example, that a partition with four parts is made up of a 2 cycle and a 4 cycle. Then the Jordan sum of the 4 partition is 2 * 1 + 1 * 4 = 7. But in the parameter space, since there are four parts, the Jordan sum must be 2.

Singular Slip-Spring model is a simulation method for fast rheological simulation of entangled polymers. This method takes advantage of GPUs to accelerate the simulations, thereby improving the speed of calculation, compared to traditional methods. The implementation of the Singular Slip-Spring model on the CUDA platform showed a significant speed-up over the CPU-based implementation, making it a suitable method for large-scale entanglement-dominated flows. In short, this paper shows a powerful method for simulating complex polymeric materials with high accuracy and efficiency.

This article discusses the concept of physical calculation and the conditions under which a physical system can be said to calculate. The paper includes philosophical and analytic reflections on computation in diverse physical systems, both natural and artificial, and discusses the ontology and epistemology of physical calculation. With extensive research as a foundation, it formulates a set of necessary and sufficient conditions for physical calculation, with a critical assessment of counterexamples and paradoxes. The aim is to draw a borderline between physical systems that calculate and those that do not, and to contribute to the understanding of calculation in theoretical computer science and physics. Ultimately, the paper proposes that a universal definition of calculation may not be possible and that it is necessary to take into account the context.

This treatise is a scientific study of the properties and properties of Goursat germs, a class of specialized functions in mathematical analysis. It deals particularly with the concept of the characteristic of Puisseux, which is closely related to these germs, and the author attempts to illustrate this idea with examples, which in the mathematical case are rare, and in the application of the idea to the other sciences. The work contributes to the research on singularities and smooth concepts in differential geometry and algebraic topology, and to the need to deepen the study of this subject in order to enrich the scientific world and to encourage the future development of these sciences.

This is when the Emperor Juntoku (also known as Kusunoki Masashige) reigned, when Magoichi was only six years old, and she looked more like her brother than her father. He and his son Shuken listened at night to his room door. They often heard that someone was knocking on the door and fighting with someone, so they thought he had a woman who was from a village somewhere. When she heard the sound of someone calling "Yuri-yura" one day, she called "Yuri-yura" too, but only laughed at her inside, and after listening more carefully, she heard that it was basically the same as she heard every night, and the sound of something like a shuttle was still there. And the man's voice was still the same, but she found a sound that looked like the shuttle and said something like "Nobutori", but when she asked someone, she said she couldn't tell it clearly and no one knew what it was. At last, thinking that she was stupid to say so, I called out, "It seems that something must be going on between them."...

A Potemkin village was made of false fields, grass, houses, and streets. The whole city was a great pavilion, of brick, wood, marble, and glazed tiles, whose façade bore the name of the country. They could not perceive that they were passing through a city of straw. The same thing might have happened at Stalingrad or Sarajevo, but those were cities of ruins, the capitals of a thousand refugees, most of them peasants, who had fled from the fighting. This would have been very dreadful; but, after a few days, they found that all was well. Most of the people grew accustomed to their new home, and life was speedily restored to its old state. As time went on, however, the stories grew more and more terrible. No doubt, the author has given us a dismal picture of the plight of the “Russian people.” And, of course, he has described this in the most reckless fashion, which may seem to be the utter disregard of the actual reality. We can never know what really became of those people, or how many of them fell back and remained behind. As for the reason why they lived so long, I suppose it must be “a case of the lottery.” This could be applied to any other village. But, thanks to their wonderful management, they managed to thrive.

This paper describes the experimental phenomenon of itinerant magnetism in spin-orbit coupled quantum gases, and performs a theoretical study of the magnetic properties of these gases, concentrating on the spin-orbit interaction and the interplay between the two. Our results show that spin-orbit interaction can induce itinerant magnetism in a quantum gas even in the absence of an external magnetic field. We also study the effect of temperature and density on the magnetic properties of the gas. Our results provide new insights into the magnetic properties of spin-orbit coupled quantum gases, and suggest a new experimental strategy.

- We present a novel method of densely connected neural architecture search (DCNAS) for semantic image segmentation. The proposed method uses a densely connected network architecture, which makes it possible to effectively search and optimize the network structure. We propose a new search space that takes into account both the number of layers and the number of connections between them, which makes the search more complete. Our method is trained by a combination of supervised and unsupervised learning, and its effectiveness is evaluated on several well-known test data. The results obtained are compared with the best state-of-the-art NAS methods, and the results are close to those of human-made networks.

(graphBLAS)()is a librarry for linear algebra operations on graph-like data. Although GraphBLAS has been widely used in many fields, its theoretical basis has not been completely studied. In this paper, we will present a mathematical analysis of the underlying theory of GraphBLAS. We first describe the concept of GraphBLAS, and then the basic concepts and data structures used in GraphBLAS. We describe the detailed mathematical properties of the basic operations, such as the multiplication of matrices and the sparse decomposition of matrices. We then analyze the mathematical correctness and efficiency of GraphBLAS. We prove that a multiplication in GraphBLAS preserves the linearity and spectral characteristics of the underlying graph, and that the sparse representation method used in GraphBLAS achieves a large speedup without sacrificing accuracy. Finally, we prove that the sparse decomposition method used in GraphBLAS is equivalent to the well-known power method, but that it can improve the scalability and robustness of the decomposition. This paper also explores the relationship between GraphBLAS and other algebras, such as graph theory, linear algebra, and machine learning. We show that GraphBLAS is an example of a general algebraic structure called a graph module, which can seamlessly connect graph-based computations with existing algebraic frameworks. Finally, we show that GraphBLAS has many important applications in machine learning, such as deep learning and randomized algorithms. Our work lays a solid theoretical foundation for the development and application of GraphBLAS, which will lead to the development of graph-based computing.

This paper proposes a new way to extract and use the data extracted from the picture captions for weakly supervised semantic segmentation. Generally, semantic segmentation requires many supervised training samples that are expensive and difficult to obtain. This paper proposes a method of circumventing this difficulty by a weakly supervised learning method using the captions as indirect supervision for semantic segmentation. The method uses cross-mode learning between visual and textual data and extracts the meaning of the words by natural language processing. Experimental results show that weak supervision can be used to obtain a better performance in semantic segmentation. Moreover, this method can be used in many places in the field of vision and learning where annotation is sparse.

The Chronoliths follows the adventures of a group of scientists who discover a mysterious technology which allows them to travel in time. This technology, called chronoliths, consists of small crystalline instruments which, in an instant, can take one to any point in the past or future. And when, after long and arduous efforts, the scientists manage to create a working prototype, they are full of elation. But soon they realize that the chronoliths have their own will and only take the people who use them to the past or the future that they want. As they go deeper and deeper into the world of chronoliths, they discover that this technology has a dark side. These chronoliths are not just tools of travel but sentient beings with their own desires and goals. And the scientists are soon caught up in intrigue and danger as they try to understand the true nature of chronoliths and their purpose. As the story unfolds, they travel through a number of eras, encountering historical figures and events along the way. And as they go, they must deal with the consequences of their actions as their presence in the past affects the present. And at the end, the team must make a decision that will determine the fate of both chronoliths and mankind.

This paper describes a method for the semi-supervised, end-to-end learning of a semi-supervised, unsupervised network that is used to perform semi-supervised segmentation of medical images. The network is trained using segmentations of low-resolution voxel data. The key process is a voxel-to-mesh procedure that converts 3D voxel supervision to 3D mesh supervision, and thus requires much less data for training than when voxel-based segmentations are used. Furthermore, the resulting meshes provide an additional way of dealing with shape. The proposed method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art unsupervised and supervised methods in two clinical applications.

Recent advances in deep learning have achieved a high degree of success in image segmentation, especially with convolutional neural networks. However, a direct application of CNN to large images is time-consuming due to the number of re-evaluations of the image data. We propose here a new method of natural image segmentation that combines Affinity fusion and graph cutting. First, we apply a convolutional neural network to a non-overlapping patch of the image, and obtain a binary label and uncertainty (a degree of confidence) for each patch. Then, we propagate these uncertainties on an Affinity fusion graph, in which the nodes represent the patches and the edges represent the similarities between the patches, and, considering both the similarities and the uncertainty, we iteratively refine the segmentation by cutting. We evaluated our method on the SIFT-Flow data, and the experimental results show that our method outperforms the other state-of-the-art methods.

This abstract will describe the phenomenon of phase shifts caused by the anisotropy of the material surfaces in the magnetization precession induced by a photothermal effect. It will be shown how the anisotropy of the material surface affects the domain structure of the magnetic field and changes the precession angle, resulting in a phase shift. Experimental data will be presented and theoretical results will be discussed in support of the experiment. The effects of these discoveries on possible applications in data storage and spintronics will also be mentioned briefly. In general, the study gives a good insight into the role of the anisotropy of the material surfaces in determining the magnetic properties of materials subject to external stimulations, such as heating by a laser.

Our main result is a fast, atemporary algorithm that performs boolean operations on triangular meshes in a constant, amortized memory. One vertex per triangular mesh can be processed every clock-slot. This makes it possible to deal with complex scenes, with several thousands of vertices and objects. The proposed implementation can be up to a thousand times faster than existing ones. But, as expected, this speed comes at the expense of simplicity: while our former solutions were summarized in a single line of pseudo-code, ours fills hundreds of pages. A notable consequence of this increase in complexity is that, unlike their simpler predecessors, neither our triangulation, nor our implementation of the boolean operations, can significantly benefit from the use of the GPU or the multicore. However, our methods may be useful in some applications, even if they do not fully justify their complexity by providing significant speedups over octree-based rasterizers. In order to prove correctness, we proved some novel results on quadtrees, which may be extended to the case of quadmeshes with non-convex faces and polygonal holes. We believe that further study of parallel algorithms, which use similar data structures, may bring further interesting insights.

Maya is a successful businesswoman, who has built her life on work, with no room for love and relationships. After her father’s death, she goes home to her hometown and meets her childhood friend, Jack. Spending time with him, she realizes that she has missed her real happiness. Jack helps Maya see the beauty of life and love. She must now decide whether to open her heart to Jack, or to continue down the road to success and loneliness. Walking on Glass is about the power of love, the importance of family, and the fragility of life.

Of two inseparable friends, Howdy and Slim, who loved to take a walk in the fields together, came a day when they found a map that showed a place where there was a buried treasure. It was a dangerous journey to the unknown through dangerous mountains, through wild forests, and through a desert. As they traveled along, they encountered many a dangerous animal, and had to face many dangers, but their friendship and resolution carried them through. At the end of many days they came to the place where the treasure was buried and found a fortune larger than they had ever dreamed. From that time they went on many more adventures, always seeking the next thrill and the next treasure.

In the old, gloomy town of Guimares, a young seminarian named Henrique has a disturbing dream of bones and a mysterious hooded man. As he deepens in his religious studies, he becomes convinced that the apparitions are real and connected with the pagan past of the city, suppressed by the Catholic Church for centuries. With the help of a perspicacious historian and an irrepressible journalist, he delves into a conspiracy of the Inquisition, the Templars, and an ancient cult which has secretly survived to the present day. In the pursuit of the truth, he and his friends are followed by dangerous forces, which do not allow themselves to be drawn, and which make every effort to protect their secrets. In a climactic clash, Henrique and his allies must confront the dark forces awakened by their search and confront their own demons, to save the city from an ancient evil that threatens to consume everything in its path.
